_meta.name: MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 — text to sfx
_meta.desc: Prompt-to-sound-effects on MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 (Apache-2.0, 1.3B DiT + DAC VAE at 48 kHz) through the MIT OF_MossSFX node. On Apple Silicon the node drives the MLX 4-bit port; weights resolve from ComfyUI's models dir or an allow-listed HF repo. OF_SaveAudioWav loudness-normalizes to −16 LUFS / −1 dBTP and ships the wav; the deprecated SaveAudio anchors the tail for the provider-side pruner, which only keeps nodes reachable from core output classes — its flac is dropped.
